Music Courses

Learn Music. Anytime. Anywhere.

Live, online classes with expert faculty, personalized learning and world class curriculum for all age groups.

Our Courses

Classical Vocal Music

Learn traditional Indian classical singing with expert guidance in ragas and talas.

Harmonium

Master the harmonium, a key instrument in Indian classical and devotional music.

Tabla

Explore the rhythmic patterns and techniques of this popular percussion instrument.

Pakhawaj

Study the traditional barrel-shaped drum used in classical and devotional music.

Flute

Learn the melodious bansuri flute with techniques for classical music expression.

Sitar

Master the sitar, a prominent string instrument in Indian classical music.

Sound Arrangement

Learn modern music production, mixing, and sound engineering techniques.

Bhajan

Sing devotional songs and bhakti geet with proper expression and musicality.

Sugam Sangeet

Enjoy learning popular and contemporary music styles with modern techniques.

Bharatanatyam

Experience the grace and precision of this classical South Indian dance form.

Kathak

Learn the storytelling dance form from North India with rhythmic footwork.
